numerical_comparison.scope: same-precision vocal-only output versus four-head vocal output on identical input, not perceptual equivalence

protocol: All 14 official validation songs, fixed 60-90s, full pretrained 11s context, no TTA, four-head strict load before optional vocal-head retention. Four fresh-process quality runs plus three fresh-process timing repeats per model. No test inference or training.
limitations: Four-stem and vocal-only use different ISTFT batch shapes
Head selection does not remove bidirectional attention or establish low latency
Latency and audio-device I/O not measured by this experiment
